title: Käsekuchen Frittata (German Cheese Frittata)
description: A rich and creamy German-inspired frittata packed with cheese and perfect for breakfast or brunch.

ingredients.name: eggs
ingredients.notes: Large eggs are best for this recipe.

ingredients.name: gruyère cheese
ingredients.notes: You can also use other Swiss-style cheese.

ingredients.name: norwegian cheese
ingredients.notes: Add a slightly sweet and nutty flavor to your frittata.

ingredients.name: yellowed cheese
ingredients.notes: This cheese adds a sharp and tangy flavor.

ingredients.name: golden mustard
ingredients.notes: Give your frittata a bit of spice with this mustard.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: Use a flaky sea salt for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: Chop the parsley finely for a fresh garnish.

instructions: Beat the eggs in a large bowl and set aside.
In a separate pan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the gruyère cheese and cook until it's melted and bubbly.
Add the norwegian cheese and yellowed cheese to the pan and stir until well combined.
Pour the beaten eggs over the cheese mixture and cook until the eggs start to set.
Transfer the pan to the preheated oven and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the cheese is golden brown.
Remove the frittata from the oven and sprinkle with salt, black pepper, and chopped parsley.
Let the frittata cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
